cv.name: Tobias Frei
cv.headline: Senior Financial Analyst – R&D Portfolio & Pipeline Valuation | ex-Lab Scientist
cv.summary: Former bench scientist who moved into finance after four years in biologics development. Since 2018 I have worked on R&D budgeting, project valuation and portfolio reviews in Basel pharma, combining a CFA charter with a scientist's reading of clinical data.

experience.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Pipeline Valuation
bullets: Build rNPV models for 14 clinical-stage assets used in quarterly portfolio decisions
Partner with clinical and regulatory leads to translate trial timelines into cost forecasts
Led the budget process for a CHF 210M R&D budget; forecast accuracy within 3% for two years
Prepared business cases for two in-licensing deals reviewed by the executive committee

experience.title: Financial Analyst, R&D Finance
bullets: Monthly accruals and variance analysis for CRO and lab service contracts
Set up a project cost dashboard in SAP BW and Power BI

experience.title: Scientist, Downstream Processing
bullets: Developed purification steps for monoclonal antibodies at pilot scale
Wrote batch records and supported technology transfer to manufacturing

skills: Clinical development phases and cost drivers
